label: Simple expense rate (단순경비율): the prior-year revenue below which it may apply
appliesTo: Individual businesses whose income may be calculated by the estimated expense-rate method
why: Read as a tax-free allowance more often than as what it is — an eligibility test for an estimated calculation method. Someone earning under ₩24m still owes income tax. And prior-year revenue is not the only gate: reaching the current-year double-entry threshold can exclude simple-rate treatment even where last year was small.

history.source: National Tax Service — 2025 income-year bookkeeping and expense-rate guidance
history.note: For the 2025 income year: Group A ₩60m, Group B ₩36m, Group C ₩24m of prior-year revenue. Specified professional occupations are excluded regardless of revenue, as are certain cash-receipt registration failures and repeated improper refusals to issue receipts. Newly commenced businesses get special treatment but remain subject to the current-year limits. The `value` field holds Group A; the display carries all three. Not independently opened at the time of writing: outbound network access was unavailable.
